scripts.build:web: emcmake cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -B build-web && cmake --build build-web -t demo
scripts.build:native: npm run gen:maps && cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -B build && cmake --build build
scripts.gen:maps: npx -y rimraf examples/demo/generated/ && python3 tools/tiny_bake.py examples/demo/assets/*.tmj -o examples/demo/generated/
scripts.web:watch: npx -y nodemon -- -e c,h,html --watch examples/demo --exec 'npm run build:web'
scripts.start: npm run gen:maps && npm run build:web && npx -y npm-run-all web:*
